Wanted: the copy at mint carries caps.timeout and caps.timeout_source in the closed record's shape, under DISPATCH_TIMEOUT, the conf default and --timeout; the watchdog's catalogue fallback stays only for records that predate the field. One S bucket: ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py and ops/conductor/tools/watchdog.py with their tests. No new refusal; every suite green; ruff clean. The plan file carries the measurements, the wants and the acceptance in full.
